lines.text: One of the biggest risks on our sites is people working around moving plant.
Always keep clear of operating plant, and never assume the operator has seen you.
Don't approach a machine until the operator has acknowledged you, and it's safe to do so.
Never walk beneath a suspended load, or enter an exclusion zone.
Only trained, competent, and authorised people may operate plant.
Check the machine before you use it,
and wear your seat belt where one is fitted.
Report any defect straight away, and take unsafe equipment out of service.
Follow the traffic management plan, and the instructions of authorised banksmen.
See them. Be seen. Stay clear.
